爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD047 花守熏Hanamori Kaori-镜前一刻
站到试衣镜前，我瞬间僵住——这、这真的能穿出去吗？
薄薄布料几乎遮不住什么，胸口和大腿凉飕飕的。
我脸红到耳根，手指捏着衣角不敢动。
镁光灯“啪”地全亮了，皮肤像被烫到。
我僵硬地按摄影师要求转身，每寸暴露的肌肤都在发麻。
手心冒汗，心里咚咚打鼓，生怕别人看出我在发抖。
“好，看镜头！”快门声密集响起，我咬住嘴唇，感觉每一道目光都扫过身体。
空气好热，呼吸变急促，只希望这段赶快结束……
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD047 Hanamori Kaori- A Moment Before the Camera
Standing in front of the dressing mirror, I froze instantly—could I really wear this out?
The thin fabric barely covered anything; my chest and thighs felt chilly.
My face flushed red to my ears, my fingers gripping the hem of my clothes, afraid to move.
The flashbulbs went off, scalding my skin.
I stiffly turned as the photographer instructed, every inch of exposed skin tingling.
My palms were sweating, my heart pounding, terrified that others would notice my trembling.
"Okay, look at the camera!" The shutter clicked rapidly. I bit my lip, feeling every gaze sweep over my body.
The air was so hot, my breathing became rapid, I just hoped this would end quickly…
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
